summary: Reported accuracy does not hold for new races. Grouped Year+Race evaluation gives much lower accuracy near its baseline, confirming race-group leakage.

findings.explanation: Random split shared every Year+Race between train and test. On the same 2024-only data, random-split accuracy stays high while group-split accuracy is much lower with similar target rates, isolating race-group leakage. Grouped evaluation clears the group overlap.
findings.title: Random split leaks race groups; performance collapses on new races
findings.family_name: Same entities or later periods in train and test

evidence.brief: flagged: 48 of 48 test groups by Year + Race also appear in training (100.0% of test rows); 47.2% of test rows have Year earlier than the latest training data (2024), so the model was trained on their future.

patch.rationale: Replace random row split with GroupShuffleSplit on Year+Race so no race appears in both train and test, matching real use on new races. Model, features and settings unchanged.

evaluations.label: Group split by Year + Race, only Year = 2024

caveats.text: Temporal evaluation is confounded by label shift with very different train and test target rates, so it does not isolate leakage.
Patched grouped split still mixes years in train and test, so residual forward-looking time overlap remains.

evidence_index.brief: clear: No preprocessing that learns from data saw test rows before the evaluation. Note: LabelEncoder at line 41 was fitted on rows including the test set, but it only learns category names, which carry no information about the labels.

flagged: 48 of 48 test groups by Year + Race also appear in training (100.0% of test rows); 47.2% of test rows have Year earlier than the latest training data (2024), so the model was trained on their future.

suspects.reason: If computed as difference to a race-level reference that uses full-race data, it could incorporate future laps not known at end of current lap
If accumulated using statistics that include future laps of the same stint/race, it would not be known at prediction time
If computed from total race laps including information only known at race end, check whether knowable at end of current lap

evidence_index.brief: clear: Suspected column(s) 'RaceProgress', 'Cumulative_Degradation', 'LapTime_Delta' were measured and none shows the strong dependence a leak would cause. Shuffling 'Cumulative_Degradation' costs 0.0255 of a 0.1428 margin above chance: modest, as for a useful feature. Whether its value is available in time cannot be shown from the data alone.
